blockdesc-shipstair-steep: A steep ship's stair with its own handrails: two cells long, rising a deck (3 blocks) at about 56°, twelve small treads. Aboard a ship in building mode (B), right-click a deck cell: it climbs away from you to the deck above, to a castle's front or up through a well over its cells (and a quarter block before its foot). Walked up and down, no climbing.
blockdesc-shipstair-long: A ship's stair with its own handrails: three cells long, rising a deck (3 blocks) at about 45°. Aboard a ship in building mode (B), right-click a deck cell: it climbs away from you to the deck above, to a castle's front or up through a well three cells long. Taken up again with left mouse held.
blockdesc-shipstair-short: A short, very steep ship's stair with its own handrails: one cell long, rising a deck (3 blocks) at about 72° in big steps. Aboard a ship in building mode (B), right-click a deck cell: it climbs away from you to the deck above, to a castle's front or up through a 2 × 1 opening over its cell and the cell before it (where you stand to climb). Walked up and down, no climbing.
blockdesc-gun-*: A cast bronze demi-culverin of about 1500 on a truck carriage. Mount it on a gun place of a ship (a port in her side, the deck around it laid): building mode, right-click the empty place with it in hand. Taken up again with an empty hand, Shift + right-click, run in and cold.

hull-already-in: That hull panel is in already.
hull-below-water: Not afloat: that panel is at or under her waterline (she'd fill). Beach her first.
hull-under-piece: Something stands against that hull panel: that first.
hull-occupied: Something is in the opening: that first.
hull-needs-planks: Laying this hull panel takes more: its planks blocks, or 4 boards for each block.
hint-hull-take: {0} · hold left mouse to take the panel out (gives {p1:# planks blocks|# planks block|# planks blocks})
hint-hull-lay: An opening in her side · right-click: lay it with {0} × {1}
hint-hull-lay-both: An opening in her side, her planking behind it out too: the sea comes in here · right-click: lay both from inside with {0} × {1} (the planking first)
hint-hull-lay-behind: Her planking behind this is out: the sea comes in here · right-click: lay it from inside with {0} × {1}
damage-behind-out: Her planking behind it is out: the sea comes in here. Lay it from inside (planks or boards, right-click)
damage-behind-cracked: Her planking behind it is cracked: mend it from inside (hold right-click with boards and nails)
repair-hint-lay: Stove in: lay it again with {p0:# planks blocks|# planks block|# planks blocks} or {p1:# boards|# board|# boards} (right-click the opening, or hold right-click on it)
rotate-needs-wrench: Turning a piece takes a wrench in hand.
rotate-nothing: That piece has no other way to face.
rotate-no-room: It fits no other way there.
hint-piece-turn: right-click: turn it (the next way it fits)
hint-cell-open: An opening in her deck · a planks block (or 4 boards) lays it again; trapdoors (one a cell, building mode) make a hatch over it: solid ones a cargo hatch, window trapdoors a glazed one
brow-not-anchored: Let go the anchor (and let her lie still) before running out the brow.
brow-gate-shut: Open the entry port's gate first; then, boards in hand, right-click it to run out the brow.
brow-no-landing: Nothing to land the brow on: a quay or the shore within 5 blocks of her side, not much higher or lower than her deck.
hint-brow: The brow · walk on to go ashore; boards in hand, right-click the gate to take it in
hint-gate-brow: Boards in hand, right-click the open gate: run out the brow to the quay (she must be anchored)
hint-gate-brow-in: boards in hand, right-click: take the brow in
beam-already-out: That length of the beam is out already.
beam-deck-in: A length of a deck beam comes out only once the deck either side of it is open: take those cells up first (an axe in building mode).
beam-too-many: At most two lengths of one beam come out, next to each other.
beam-under-piece: Something hangs on that beam or stands in its way (a partition, a lantern, a stair): that first.
beam-under-fixture: Part of her rests on that beam: it stays.
beam-fixed: This beam doesn't come out (a deck's edge, a mast's partners, or her fittings rest on it).
flight-beam: A deck beam is in the way: open the deck on both sides of it (take those cells up with an axe in building mode) and put the stair here again: the beam comes out with it.
flight-beam-fixed: A beam that can't come out is in the way (a deck's edge, a mast's partners): put the stair elsewhere, or the other way round (across her, between two beams).
hint-port-take: A gun port's place boarded over · hold left mouse to take the board out (then a port can go in: a trapdoor)
hint-port-lay: A gun port · right-click: plank it over with {0} × {1}
port-already-open: That gun port is open already.
port-has-gun: Take up the gun first (empty hand, Shift + right-click it).
gunplace-port-covered: The port is planked over: take the planking out first (an axe in building mode).
hint-beam-take: A length of a deck beam ({0}) · hold left mouse to take it out (carlings frame the opening)
hint-beam-lay: A deck beam cut here · right-click: put it back with {0} × {1}
hint-stair-beam: the deck beam in its way comes out with it ({p0:# lengths|# length|# lengths}, planks back)
port-not-in: There's no port in her side there.
port-needs-opening: Take the board out of her side there first (an axe in building mode): the port goes into the opening.
port-in-there: A gun port is in her side there: take it out first (an axe in building mode), then board the opening over.
hull-port-in: A gun port is in her side there: take it out first (an axe in building mode), then plank the opening.
gunplace-no-port: There's no port in her side here: put a port into the opening (a trapdoor, building mode).
hint-port-out: A gun port in her side · hold left mouse to take it out (its trapdoor back; the opening stays, planks close it)
hint-port-in: An opening in her side at a gun's place · right-click: put a lidded port in with the {0}
